LESSON: SELF- EXPLORATION AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 1.3: Self- Exploration and Career Development
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Self- Exploration and Career Development, part of Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How are talents and abilities nurtured? 2. Why is self- exploration necessary for career development?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Self- Exploration and Career Development together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: learner interprets and makes inference when reading and analysing a case scenario

on ethical and unethical practices related to the use of talents and abilities.

• Creativity and Imagination: learner acquires networking skills by undertaking group activities and exchanging new ideas

that inspire creative thinking skills during the display of talents and abilities through clubs, societies and other planned

school fora.

Values:
● Integrity: learner develops accountability when analysing a case scenario on ethical and unethical practices related to the

13

use of talents and abilities.

• Respect: learner shows humility by displaying positive regard for self and others when discussing and presenting on ways

of nurturing talents and abilities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social Cohesion: learner cooperates with others when demonstrating their talents and abilities during talent shows.

• Peer Education and Mentorship: learner displays talents and abilities through clubs and societies and other planned school

fora.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: How are talents and abilities nurtured? 2. Why is self- exploration necessary for career development?
